fields.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is sent and nothing is queued.
fields.label: Enable eTIMS Integration

fields.description: Background queues the invoice and returns immediately - the right choice almost always. Synchronous waits for the signature, for POS counters that must print the QR code straight away.
fields.label: Submission Mode

fields.description: Only meaningful in Synchronous mode. Off means the invoice submits and the Transmission retries in the background.
fields.label: Block Invoice Submission on Failure

fields.description: Used for non-POS invoices, which carry no payment rows to split.
fields.label: Default Payment Type

fields.description: A signature cannot be withdrawn from KRA. The compliant way to reverse a fiscalised sale is a credit note, so cancelling one is blocked by default.
fields.label: Allow Cancelling Fiscalised Invoices

fields.description: Applies only to transport faults. A payload the device rejected is never retried automatically - it is parked as Blocked with the remedy attached.
fields.label: Max Retries

fields.options: Maps an Item Tax Template to the eTIMS VAT band it represents. An item with no band here and none on the Item itself is never guessed at - its invoice is blocked instead, because a wrong band is rejected by eTIMS (E321) and misdeclares tax.

fields.description: Queue an item for registration when it is created or its eTIMS fields change.
fields.label: Register Items Automatically

fields.description: Sends stock deltas so the device's own stock does not deplete (E090/E351).
fields.label: Push Stock Changes to Device

fields.description: Calls the device's manual-upload endpoint when its backlog stops shrinking.
fields.label: Force Upload When Invoices Stall

fields.description: Raise an alert when a device holds more than this many invoices KRA has not taken.
fields.label: Backlog Alert Threshold
